summary.recommendation: Entries with matchAmbiguity=null can safely use 'Par caractéristiques' lookup. Ambiguous entries should ideally be resolved via 'Par véhicule' path, or the UI should prompt the user to confirm make/model when a conflict is detected. Major conflicts (viscosity or ACEA differs) carry a real risk of recommending the wrong oil. Minor conflicts (API or OEM spec differs) may indicate incomplete sourcing or regional differences.
